front.title: Applying Generate Random Extensions And Sustain Extensibility (GREASE) to LAKE Extensibility

abstract.t: This document applies the extensibility mechanism GREASE (Generate Random Extensions And Sustain Extensibility), which was pioneered for TLS, to the ecosystem of the LAKE protocol (also called EDHOC). It reserves a set of External Authorization Data (EAD) labels and unusable cipher suites that may be included in messages to ensure peers correctly handle unknown values.
